description: Human-annotated retrieval ground truth dataset for Confidence Memo Agent across 4 public domain datasets. Queries are independently composed to avoid verbatim text leakage and include positive, negative, and edge-case queries.

queries.query: eye strain reading at night dark background
queries.human_justification: Tickets gp_1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1009, 1010 explicitly request dark theme/night mode to alleviate brightness and eye pain.

queries.query: special character playlist search failure
queries.human_justification: Only gp_1005 discusses playlist search errors with non-standard characters.

queries.query: application freeze force close on Android OS settings
queries.human_justification: Only gp_1007 reports app crashing when opening settings on Android 14.

queries.query: listen to tracks without internet connection
queries.human_justification: Only gp_1006 discusses offline playback and sync issues.

queries.query: audio streaming power consumption drain
queries.human_justification: Only gp_1008 reports high battery usage during background streaming.

queries.query: cryptocurrency bitcoin payment integration in app
queries.human_justification: Zero tickets in the Google Play corpus reference crypto or bitcoin; tests system false positive resistance.

queries.query: search query latency and timeout on big repositories
queries.human_justification: GH-201 concerns 504 timeouts on >50k files; GH-205 concerns latency degradation under concurrent queries.

queries.query: boolean filter parsing drops author and tag criteria
queries.human_justification: GH-202 describes search filters dropping author: and tag: parameters.

queries.query: approximate string matching returns unrelated results
queries.human_justification: GH-203 describes fuzzy search matching login with logging.

queries.query: regular expression pattern search in code bar
queries.human_justification: GH-204 requests regex matching support.

queries.query: daemon memory accumulation and socket leak
queries.human_justification: GH-206 reports RSS growth from unclosed WebSockets.

queries.query: access token refresh failure in background auth
queries.human_justification: GH-207 describes silent OAuth refresh token expiration failure.

queries.query: quick command palette hotkey keyboard shortcut
queries.human_justification: GH-208 requests Cmd+K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut.

queries.query: iOS Swift compilation linker error architecture arm64
queries.human_justification: Zero tickets relate to iOS Swift compilation.

queries.query: single sign on Google workspace 403 access denied
queries.human_justification: cs_301 describes OAuth 403 authorization error during SSO.

queries.query: credential recovery URL expiration 404 error
queries.human_justification: cs_302 describes broken password reset link with 404 Expired Token.

queries.query: 2FA multi-factor authentication SMS delivery failure
queries.human_justification: cs_303 concerns SMS 2FA code non-delivery to UK numbers.

queries.query: unexpected session logout while navigating portal
queries.human_justification: cs_304 describes automatic logout every 5 minutes.

queries.query: infinite redirect loop on enterprise identity provider SAML
queries.human_justification: cs_306 concerns continuous redirect loop during SAML authentication.

queries.query: subscription billing seat count invoice discrepancies
queries.human_justification: cs_307 reports incorrect seat count on invoice.

queries.query: passwordless email link delivered to junk folder
queries.human_justification: cs_308 concerns magic link emails flagged as spam.

queries.query: standby idle power depletion overnight
queries.human_justification: AMZ_902 reports 60% battery drain overnight on standby.

queries.query: high temperature thermal risk when fast charging
queries.human_justification: AMZ_904 describes burning hot device during fast charging as a fire hazard.

queries.query: overall short battery runtime compared to manufacturer specs
queries.human_justification: AMZ_901 (dies in 4 hours vs 12 advertised), AMZ_902 (drains on standby), and AMZ_905 (requests low-power mode to extend runtime) all address insufficient operational runtime.

queries.query: waterproof IP68 water submersion resistance rating
queries.human_justification: Zero reviews discuss water resistance or IP ratings.
